_doc: Ambient insect surfaces (docs/kb/art/wildlife.md, M3-CRE-616); write_materials.py writes assets/wildlife/insect/materials/<slot>.tres on game/world/wildlife/wildlife.gdshader. moth: matte and dusty (a fine, high detail noise for the fur and wing scales). dragonfly: the wetness channel carries the gloss (wings 0, body 0.35, eyes 0.8 in build_insect.py; wet_darken 1 so it only changes the shine), with a faint rim sheen so the wings glint. flutter_pivot is build_insect.py's wing root (*_WING_ROOT_X, *_WING_Y); flutter_split_z its DF_SPLIT_Z (the hind pair lies behind it and beats flutter_hind_lag radians later; the moth's pairs beat together). firefly (Ch10, M4-A2P-056): a matte dusky beetle whose lantern (the body behind glow_tail_z, build_insect.py FF_LANTERN_Z) glows glow_color at up to glow_energy, scaled per instance by its blink (mode 6: the flutter, with the blink in the mode parameter); lit, the lantern swells about glow_centre (the lantern's middle) from glow_radius (its own) toward glow_angle radians of the view at its distance, times the blink, so it reads as a point of light at any distance. glow_color is sun_gold mixed 30% toward palm_green: warm yellow-green, never a glimmer swatch (wildlife is never glimmer). Its hind wings beat under the still-raised wing covers (they share the flutter mask, so the covers beat too, a little: flutter_angle is low).
